summary: PGIM Private Credit Fund filed a Form 8-K reporting routine monthly distributions for Class S, D, and I shares, with amounts ranging from $0.19506 to $0.21243 per share, payable August 28, 2026 to holders of record July 31, 2026. It also disclosed NAV per share as of June 30, 2026, alongside aggregate NAV of $294 million and portfolio fair value of $430 million. Offering updates show continued issuance of shares. No special-situation transaction, strategic initiative, or structural change is present; the filing is purely operational and routine.
